relations.rationale: Team membership is unrelated to relative ages.
Milo being on Jun's team doesn't determine whether Jun and Hana share a team.
If Milo is on Jun's team, and if Jun/Hana are on different teams, this is consistent with Milo not being on Hana's team, providing weak support.
Team membership of Milo and Jun has no bearing on past race rankings of Hana and Isla.
Team composition is unrelated to weather/sun conditions at race start.
Age difference doesn't imply anything about their readiness for the climb.
Zeno's age relative to Isla has no bearing on Hana's and Isla's past race rankings.
Zeno and Isla's readiness has nothing to do with Milo's height relative to other cyclists.
Their readiness level is unrelated to Isla's statement about race start timing.
Current readiness for a climb doesn't relate to Isla's finishing place in a previous year's event.
Hana laughing at Zeno's weather comment is unrelated to Isla's statement about race timing.
Hana laughing about the weather forecast doesn't determine whether the sun actually broke through, though it's thematically related to weather, it doesn't confirm or deny the outcome.
The group moving together is unrelated to specific team membership between Jun and Hana.
Moving toward the starting line together doesn't inform team membership specifics.
The group moving toward the starting line together supports the idea that they later surge forward as a pack.
Team membership status is unrelated to Isla checking her watch.
Jun not being on Hana's team doesn't determine whether Milo is on Hana's team.
Team membership is unrelated to weather conditions at the start.
Jun and Hana's team relationship is unrelated to the pack's movement around the bend.
Milo being nearly six feet tall supports the claim that he towered over most other cyclists.
